name: Alok
introEn: Active aura that heals Alok and nearby allies, boosts their movement speed and drops music notes.
introHi: Alok ka active aura, jo Alok aur paas ke teammates ko heal karta hai, movement speed badhata hai aur music notes drop karta hai.
currentEn: Creates a 5m aura that increases movement speed by 15% and restores 5 HP/s for 10 seconds. While the aura is active, a music note drops 2m behind Alok every 2 seconds and lasts 5 seconds. Teammates who pick up a note gain 15% movement speed and 5 HP/s for 10 seconds. Multiple Drop the Beat auras do not stack.
currentHi: 5m ka aura banta hai, jo movement speed 15% badhata hai aur 10 seconds tak 5 HP/s restore karta hai. Aura active hone par har 2 seconds mein Alok ke 2m peeche ek music note drop hota hai, jo 5 seconds rehta hai. Note pick karne wale teammate ko 10 seconds ke liye 15% movement speed aur 5 HP/s milta hai. Drop the Beat ke multiple auras stack nahi hote.

rows.hi: Music note kitni der rehta hai

notesEn: While Alok's own skill is active, teammates' Alok auras give no benefit (OB53). Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it (OB54). Since OB47 the awakened skill replaces the original for all players; both appearances remain available.
notesHi: Alok ka apna skill active ho, toh teammates ke Alok aura se use koi benefit nahi milta (OB53). Movement speed ki global limit hai; skills, items aur events ke bonuses is limit se upar nahi ja sakte (OB54). OB47 se awakened skill sab players ke liye original skill ki jagah aa gaya; dono appearances available hain.
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): HP recovery 5 to 3 HP/s, cooldown 50s to 45s.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Awakened Alok introduced.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): HP recovery 3 to 5 HP/s, movement speed 15%, duration 10s; music-note pickup healing 3 to 5 HP/s.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Awakened skill replaced the original for all players.
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): Fixed skill range not matching the visual range, and speed boost sometimes failing to apply.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Alok users no longer gain from teammates' Alok auras while their own skill is active.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): 9th Anniversary event Skill Boosts: Speed Remix (10m aura, teammates +16% speed) and Heal Remix (20 HP/s while active). Global movement-speed cap added.
historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): HP recovery 5 se 3 HP/s; cooldown 50s se 45s hua.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Awakened Alok introduce hua.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): HP recovery 3 se 5 HP/s, movement speed 15%, duration 10s; music-note pickup healing 3 se 5 HP/s hui.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Awakened skill sab players ke liye original ki jagah aaya.
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): Skill range aur visual range match na hone, aur speed boost kabhi apply na hone ka issue fix hua.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Apna skill active hone par Alok users ko teammates ke Alok aura se benefit nahi milta.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): 9th Anniversary Skill Boosts—Speed Remix (10m aura, teammates ko +16% speed) aur Heal Remix (active rehte 20 HP/s). Global movement-speed cap add hua.

name: A124
introEn: Electromagnetic wave that blocks enemy skills, deals damage and interrupts interactions.
introHi: A124 ki electromagnetic wave enemy skills block karti hai, damage deti hai aur interactions ko interrupt karti hai.
currentEn: Unleashes an 8m electromagnetic wave. Enemies inside cannot activate skills, take 25 DMG, and have their interaction countdowns (such as reviving) interrupted.
currentHi: A124 ek electromagnetic wave release karta hai, jo enemy skills ko disable karti hai, damage deti hai aur interactions rok deti hai.
notesEn: Skill can be cancelled while aiming. Joseph is immune to A124's interference.
notesHi: Aim karte waqt skill cancel ki ja sakti hai. Joseph A124 ke interference se immune hai.
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Reworked into an 8m wave that disables enemy skills.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Added 25 DMG, duration 30s to 20s, cooldown 75s to 50s, cancel while aiming.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): 8m wave mein rework hui, jo enemy skills disable karti hai.
OB42 (Oct 2023): 25 DMG add hua; duration 30s se 20s aur cooldown 75s se 50s hua; aim karte waqt cancel karna add hua.

name: Andrew
introEn: Passive that slows armor durability loss and adds armor damage reduction, boosted by nearby teammates.
introHi: Passive skill jo armor ki durability loss slow karta hai aur armor damage reduction deta hai; paas ke teammates se bonus badhta hai.
currentEn: Armor loses durability 40% slower. Wolf Pack adds 4% armor damage reduction, plus 1% for every teammate within 15m.
currentHi: Armor ki durability 40% dheere khatam hoti hai. Wolf Pack 4% armor damage reduction deta hai, aur 15m ke andar har teammate par 1% extra milta hai.
notesEn: Shield Points ignore armor damage-reduction buffs, so Wolf Pack does not reduce damage taken by Shield Points. The OB46 notes do not state whether teammates must also carry Wolf Pack. Since OB47 the awakened skill replaces the original for all players.
notesHi: Shield Points armor damage-reduction buffs ko ignore karte hain, isliye Wolf Pack Shield Points se hone wale damage ko kam nahi karta. OB46 notes mein clear nahi hai ki teammates ke paas bhi Wolf Pack hona zaroori hai ya nahi. OB47 se awakened skill sab players ke liye original ki jagah aa gaya.
historyEn: OB40 (Jun 2023): Armor durability loss reduction 20% to 25%.
OB41 (Aug 2023): Armor damage reduction 20% to 15%, teammate bonus 10% to 5%.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Armor durability loss reduction 25% to 40%; armor damage reduction 15% to 5%, +5% per teammate carrying the skill.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Now +4%, +1% per teammate within 15m.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Awakened skill replaced the original for all players.
historyHi: OB40 (Jun 2023): Armor durability loss reduction 20% se 25% hua.
OB41 (Aug 2023): Armor damage reduction 20% se 15%, teammate bonus 10% se 5% hua.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Armor durability loss reduction 25% se 40%; armor damage reduction 15% se 5%, aur skill carry karne wale har teammate par +5%.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Ab +4%, aur 15m ke andar har teammate par +1%.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Awakened skill sab players ke liye original ki jagah aaya.

name: Antonio
introEn: Passive that starts the match with extra Shield Points that recover after combat.
introHi: Passive skill jo match start par extra Shield Points deta hai; combat ke baad ye recover hote hain.
currentEn: Starts the match with 20 extra Shield Points. Shield Points recover after surviving combat.
currentHi: Antonio match ki shuruaat extra Shield Points ke saath karta hai, jo combat ke baad recover hote hain.

rows.en: Armor damage reduction on Shield Points
rows.hi: Shield Points par armor damage reduction

notesEn: Shield Points are removed before HP. Shield Points ignore armor damage-reduction buffs. Shield Points do not protect against Danger Zone, fall or bleeding damage.
notesHi: HP se pehle Shield Points consume hote hain. Shield Points armor damage-reduction buffs ko ignore karte hain. Danger Zone, fall ya bleeding damage se Shield Points protection nahi dete.
historyEn: OB41 (Aug 2023): 40 extra HP converted to 40 Shield Points.
2024: recovery speed 10 to 5 SP/s.
historyHi: OB41 (Aug 2023): 40 extra HP ko 40 Shield Points mein convert kiya gaya.
OB43 (Jan 2024): 40 se 30 hue.
2024: Recovery speed 10 se 5 SP/s hui.

name: A-Patroa
lastChanged: No balance changes since release (OB34, May 2022)
introEn: Utility character with an exclusive extra skill slot; no personal combat skill.
introHi: Utility character jiske paas ek extra exclusive skill slot hai; iska apna combat skill nahi hai.
currentEn: Adds one extra skill slot that can hold any skill owned on the account.
currentHi: A-Patroa ek extra exclusive skill slot deta hai; iska personal combat skill nahi hai.
historyEn: OB34 (May 2022): Released.
historyHi: OB34 (May 2022): Release hua.

name: Paloma
introEn: Passive that boosts weapon accuracy after she destroys a Gloo Wall.
introHi: Passive skill jo Gloo Wall destroy karne ke baad weapon accuracy badhata hai.
currentEn: Destroying a Gloo Wall increases weapon accuracy for 10 seconds.
currentHi: Paloma Gloo Wall destroy karne ke baad weapon accuracy boost karti hai.
notesEn: Garena does not publish the accuracy bonus value. Designed to break enemy cover and finish players hiding behind Gloo Walls.
notesHi: Garena accuracy bonus ki exact value publish nahi karta. Ye enemy cover todne aur Gloo Wall ke peeche chhupe players ko finish karne ke liye useful hai.
historyEn: OB49 (21 May 2025): Reworked. Her extra-ammo skill was replaced by Shatterburst.
historyHi: OB49 (21 May 2025): Rework hua; extra-ammo skill ki jagah Shatterburst aaya.

name: Laura
introEn: Passive that increases accuracy while Laura is scoped in.
introHi: Passive skill jo scope mein rehkar aim karne par Laura ki accuracy badhata hai.
currentEn: Accuracy increases by 60% while scoped in.
currentHi: Laura scope mein ho toh uski accuracy increase hoti hai.
notesEn: Built to help long-range shooters land shots.
notesHi: Long-range players ko shots connect karne mein help karta hai.
historyEn: OB28 (Jun 2021): Accuracy bonus raised, maximum 30% to 35%.
OB36 (Sep 2022): Maximum 35% to 50%.
historyHi: OB28 (Jun 2021): Accuracy bonus ka maximum 30% se 35% hua.
OB36 (Sep 2022): Maximum 35% se 50% hua.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Maximum 50% se 60% hua.

name: Rafael
introEn: Passive that silences sniper and marksman fire and speeds up bleeding on knocked-down enemies.
introHi: Passive skill jo sniper aur marksman fire ko silent karta hai, aur knocked-down enemies ki bleed speed badhata hai.
currentEn: With Sniper Rifles and Marksman Rifles, firing sound is silenced and enemies knocked down by Rafael bleed 85% faster.
currentHi: Sniper aur Marksman Rifles se fire karte waqt sound silent rehta hai, aur knocked-down enemies ki bleed speed fast hoti hai.
notesEn: Works while using Sniper Rifles or Marksman Rifles.
notesHi: Sniper Rifles ya Marksman Rifles use karte waqt kaam karta hai.
historyEn: OB27 (Apr 2021): Became a passive skill that silences sniper and marksman fire.
OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Limited to Sniper and Marksman Rifles; bleed speed bonus raised, maximum 45% to 90%.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill description corrected to match the actual effect.
historyHi: OB27 (Apr 2021): Passive skill bana, sniper aur marksman fire silent hua.
OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Sniper aur Marksman Rifles tak limit hua; bleed speed bonus maximum 45% se 90% hua.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill description ko actual effect ke hisaab se correct kiya gaya.

name: Jota
introEn: Passive that restores HP when Jota hits and knocks down enemies.
introHi: Passive skill jo Jota ke hit karne aur enemy ko knock karne par HP restore karta hai.
currentEn: Hitting an enemy with guns restores some HP. Knocking down an enemy in any way restores 20% HP.
currentHi: Jota hit karne aur enemy ko knockdown karne par HP restore karta hai.
notesEn: Garena does not publish the HP restored per gun hit.
Before OB53, only knockdowns scored with guns triggered the recovery.
notesHi: Garena har gun hit par restore hone wali HP ki exact value publish nahi karta. OB53 se pehle sirf gun se kiye knockdown par recovery trigger hoti thi.
historyEn: Before OB29: SMG or Shotgun kills restored HP, 5-second cooldown.
OB29 (Aug 2021): Reworked so gun hits restore HP and knockdowns restore up to 20% max HP.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Any type of knockdown now triggers the recovery.
historyHi: OB29 se pehle: SMG ya Shotgun kills par HP restore hota tha, 5-second cooldown ke saath.
OB29 (Aug 2021): Rework hua—gun hits par HP restore, knockdown par max HP ka 20% tak restore.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Ab kisi bhi type ka knockdown recovery trigger karta hai.

name: Clu
introEn: Active scan that reveals enemy positions and shares them with the squad.
introHi: Active scan jo enemy ki location reveal karta hai aur squad ke saath share karta hai.
currentEn: Locates enemies within 80m who are not prone or crouching for 10 seconds. Enemy positions are shared with teammates.
currentHi: Clu scan se enemy positions reveal hoti hain aur squad ke saath share hoti hain.
notesEn: Prone or crouching enemies are not revealed.
Scanned enemies get a notification on their minimap and screen.
notesHi: Prone ya crouch kar rahe enemies reveal nahi hote. Scan hone par enemy ke minimap aur screen par notification aata hai.
historyEn: OB34 (25 May 2022): Duration 5-7.5s to 5-10s, cooldown 75-60s to 75-50s by level.
OB37 (Nov 2022): Maximum scan range 75m to 65m.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Cooldown 50s to 45s; scanned enemies now get a notification.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Scan range 65m to 80m.
historyHi: OB34 (25 May 2022): Duration 5–7.5s se 5–10s; cooldown 75–60s se level ke hisaab se 75–50s hua.
OB37 (Nov 2022): Maximum scan range 75m se 65m hui.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Cooldown 50s se 45s hua; scanned enemies ko notification milne laga.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Scan range 65m se 80m hui.

name: Wolfrahh
introEn: Passive that grows with every elimination: tougher against headshots and stronger headshots.
introHi: Passive skill jo har elimination ke saath stronger hota hai: headshots se protection badhti hai aur headshot damage bhi boost hota hai.
currentEn: Every elimination adds one spectator, and spectators never decrease. Each spectator reduces headshot damage taken by 4% and increases headshot damage dealt by 10%.
currentHi: Har elimination ke saath Wolfrahh ka effect badhta hai—headshot damage kam leta hai aur headshot damage zyada deta hai.
notesEn: Maximum effect is reached at 3 spectators.
notesHi: Maximum effect 3 spectators par milta hai.
historyEn: OB22 (May 2020): Introduced.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Spectators required reduced from 6 to 3; limb damage bonus replaced with headshot damage bonus.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Headshot damage taken reduction 7% to 4% per spectator, maximum 21% to 12%.
historyHi: OB22 (May 2020): Introduced hua.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Required spectators 6 se 3 hue; limb damage bonus ki jagah headshot damage bonus aaya.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Headshot damage taken reduction har spectator par 7% se 4%, maximum 21% se 12% hui.

name: Jai
introEn: Passive that refills Jai's magazine after a knockdown or an active skill.
introHi: Passive skill jo knockdown ya active skill use karne ke baad Jai ki magazine refill karta hai.

rows.value: Knocking down an enemy or using an active skill
Assault Rifles, Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles

currentEn: After knocking down an enemy or using an active skill, the gun's magazine reloads automatically to 100% of its maximum capacity.
currentHi: Enemy ko knockdown karne ya active skill use karne ke baad gun ki magazine automatically maximum capacity ke 100% tak refill ho jaati hai.
notesEn: Works with Assault Rifles, Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns and Sniper Rifles. The active-skill trigger leaves Jai with a loaded weapon right after using a skill.
notesHi: Assault Rifles, Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns aur Sniper Rifles par kaam karta hai. Active skill use karne ke turant baad Jai ke paas loaded weapon hota hai.
historyEn: Sep 2020 (Booyah Day): Reload capacity maximum 25% to 45%; Shotguns added.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Reworked. Magazine now refills after a knockdown or an active skill, to 100% for all weapon types including Sniper Rifles.
historyHi: Sep 2020 (Booyah Day): Reload capacity maximum 25% se 45% hui; Shotguns add hue.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Rework hua. Ab knockdown ya active skill ke baad magazine 100% refill hoti hai, Sniper Rifles samet sab weapon types par.

name: Alvaro
introEn: Passive that boosts explosive damage and range, and splits each grenade into mini grenades after it explodes.
introHi: Passive skill jo explosive damage aur range badhata hai, aur grenade explode hone ke baad use mini grenades mein split karta hai.
currentEn: Explosive weapon damage increases by 20% and range increases by 10%. Each grenade splits into 3 mini grenades after exploding, dealing 20% of the original grenade's damage.
currentHi: Explosive weapon damage 20% aur range 10% badhti hai. Har grenade explode hone ke baad 3 mini grenades mein split hota hai, jo original grenade ke damage ka 20% deal karte hain.
notesEn: Grenades split only after exploding, so grenade cooking is no longer disrupted (OB47). Since OB47 this skill replaces Art of Demolition for all players.
notesHi: Grenade explode hone ke baad hi split hota hai, isliye grenade cook karna ab interrupt nahi hota (OB47). OB47 se ye skill sab players ke liye Art of Demolition ki jagah aa gaya.
historyEn: OB29 (Aug 2021): Art of Demolition damage bonus raised, maximum 16% to 20%.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Awakened Alvaro "Rageblast" introduced with Split Blitz: +20% damage, +10% range, grenades split into 3 extra grenades 1 second before detonating at 30% damage.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Split Blitz replaced Art of Demolition for all players; grenades now split after exploding, mini grenades deal 20%.
historyHi: OB29 (Aug 2021): Art of Demolition damage bonus maximum 16% se 20% hua.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Awakened Alvaro “Rageblast” ke saath Split Blitz aaya: +20% damage, +10% range; grenade detonate hone se 1 second pehle 3 extra grenades mein split hota tha, 30% damage ke saath.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Split Blitz sab players ke liye Art of Demolition ki jagah aaya; grenade ab explode hone ke baad split hota hai aur mini grenades 20% damage karte hain.

name: Miguel
introEn: Passive that restores EP for every enemy Miguel knocks down.
introHi: Passive skill jo Miguel ke har enemy knockdown par EP restore karta hai.
currentEn: Gains 200 EP for each knockdown.
currentHi: Miguel har knockdown par 200 EP gain karta hai.
notesEn: Triggers on knockdowns, not eliminations. Can be paired with other recovery skills.
notesHi: Knockdown par trigger hota hai, elimination par nahi. Dusri recovery skills ke saath pair kar sakte ho.
historyEn: OB35 (Aug 2022): Crazy Slayer now triggers on knockdowns instead of eliminations, 30-80 EP by level.
OB36 (Sep 2022): EP per knockdown 30-80 to 100-200.
historyHi: OB35 (Aug 2022): Crazy Slayer elimination ki jagah knockdown par trigger hone laga, level ke hisaab se 30–80 EP.
OB36 (Sep 2022): Har knockdown par EP 30–80 se 100–200 hua.

name: Nikita
introEn: Passive that speeds up reloads and reduces enemy healing on every hit.
introHi: Passive skill jo reload speed badhata hai aur har hit par enemy ki healing reduce karta hai.
currentEn: Reload speed increases by 20%. Every time Nikita hits an enemy, that target gets a 50% healing reduction for 6 seconds (maximum 50%).
currentHi: Reload speed 20% badhti hai. Nikita jab bhi enemy ko hit karti hai, target ki healing 6 seconds ke liye 50% reduce ho jaati hai (maximum 50%).
notesEn: Built to counter high-healing characters such as Ford and Kassie. Hits do not stack the reduction beyond the 50% maximum. A visual indicator now shows when you apply Healing Reduction on an enemy (OB54).
notesHi: Ford aur Kassie jaise high-healing characters ko counter karne ke liye useful hai. Hits se reduction 50% maximum se upar stack nahi hoti. OB54 mein enemy par Healing Reduction apply hone ka visual indicator add hua.
historyEn: OB37 (Nov 2022): Reload speed 14-24% to a flat 20%.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Reworked: reload speed +20%, 30% healing reduction for 10s.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Healing reduction 30% to 50%, duration 10s to 6s; reload speed 30%.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Reload speed 30% to 20%.
historyHi: OB37 (Nov 2022): Reload speed 14–24% se fixed 20% hui.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Rework—reload speed +20%, 10s ke liye 30% healing reduction.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Healing reduction 30% se 50%, duration 10s se 6s; reload speed 30% hui.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Reload speed 30% se 20% hui.

name: Kapella
introEn: Passive that lets any weapon heal teammates and boosts Heal Pistol healing.
introHi: Passive skill jisse kisi bhi weapon se teammates ko heal kar sakte hain aur Heal Pistol ki healing bhi badhti hai.
currentEn: Shooting teammates with any weapon heals them for 20% of the damage dealt. Heal Pistols have a 20% higher healing effect.
currentHi: Kisi bhi weapon se teammate ko shoot karne par dealt damage ka 20% heal hota hai. Heal Pistol ki healing effect 20% zyada hoti hai.
notesEn: Pairs with the Heal Pistol-Y, which helps up downed teammates by shooting them (OB49).
notesHi: Heal Pistol-Y ke saath useful hai; OB49 mein ye downed teammates ko shoot karke help-up karta hai.
historyEn: OB21 (Apr 2020): Introduced with Healing Song.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Healing Song reworked: 80 HP shield and 10% speed boost on help-up, downed teammates bleed 35% slower.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Help-up speed boost 10% to 80%.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Reworked into Remedy Rounds.
historyHi: OB21 (Apr 2020): Healing Song ke saath introduce hui.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Healing Song rework—help-up par 80 HP shield aur 10% speed boost; downed teammates 35% dheere bleed karte hain.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Help-up speed boost 10% se 80% hui.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Remedy Rounds mein rework hui.

name: Joseph
introEn: Passive that grants immunity to disruptive effects and a short movement-speed boost.
introHi: Passive jo disruptive effects se immunity aur short movement-speed boost deta hai.
currentEn: Become immune to disruptive effects (slowdown, marking, skill-silencing) and gain a 10% movement-speed boost for 5 seconds.
currentHi: Slowdown, marking aur skill-silencing jaise disruptive effects se immunity milti hai aur 5 seconds ke liye 10% movement-speed boost milta hai.
notesEn: Immune to Moco's marking, Homer's drone and A124's nano interference. Garena does not publish the exact trigger condition. Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it (OB54).
notesHi: Moco ki marking, Homer ke drone aur A124 ke nano interference se immune. Garena exact trigger condition publish nahi karta. Movement speed ki global maximum limit hai; skills, items aur events ke bonuses usse exceed nahi kar sakte (OB54).
historyEn: OB35 (Jul 2022): Original skill Nutty Movement had its speed boost lowered.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Reworked into Silver Spoon: immunity and 10% speed for 5s, cooldown 60s.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Cooldown 60s to 45s.
historyHi: OB35 (Jul 2022): Original Nutty Movement skill ka speed boost kam hua.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Silver Spoon mein rework—immunity aur 5s ke liye 10% speed, cooldown 60s.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Cooldown 60s se 45s hua.

name: Wukong
introEn: Active skill that turns Wukong into a bush for ambushes and repositioning.
introHi: Active skill jo Wukong ko bush mein badal deta hai, ambush aur repositioning ke liye.
currentEn: Transforms into a bush with a 10% reduction in movement speed for 10 seconds. The transformation ends when Wukong attacks. The cooldown resets if Wukong takes down an enemy within 10 seconds after releasing the skill.
currentHi: Wukong 10 seconds ke liye bush ban jata hai aur movement speed 10% kam hoti hai. Attack karte hi transformation end ho jata hai. Skill release karne ke 10 seconds ke andar enemy takedown karne par cooldown reset hota hai.

rows.value: On a takedown within 10 seconds of release

notesEn: Interactions that keep Camouflage: using Vending Machines, War Chests and Portal Go, eating Mushrooms, helping up teammates. Interactions that remove Camouflage: using vehicles, ziplines and Launch Pads (OB47).
notesHi: Camouflage bana rehta hai: Vending Machines, War Chests aur Portal Go use karna, Mushrooms khana, teammates ko revive/help up karna. Camouflage hat jata hai: vehicles, ziplines aur Launch Pads use karne par (OB47).
historyEn: Sep 2021: Movement speed reduced by 20% while camouflaged.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Speed reduction 20% to 10%.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Speed reduction 10% to 5%, cooldown 200s.
OB43 (24 Jan 2024): Speed reduction removed.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Cooldown 200s to 75s.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Cooldown 75s to 90s; interactions allowed without breaking Camouflage.
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): 10% speed reduction added, duration 15s to 10s, cooldown 120s to 90s, cooldown reset limited to takedowns within 10s of release.

OB54 (23 Jun 2026): 9th Anniversary event Skill Boosts: Camo Decoy (leaves a moving decoy that disappears after 10 DMG, 10s or when Wukong returns to human form) and Cloned Camo (two extra bushes, lasting 10s).
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Cooldown 90s to 75s.
historyHi: Sep 2021: Camouflage mein movement speed 20% kam hui.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Speed reduction 20% se 10% hua.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Speed reduction 10% se 5%, cooldown 200s.
OB43 (24 Jan 2024): Speed reduction hata di gayi.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Cooldown 200s se 75s hua.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Cooldown 75s se 90s; interactions se Camouflage break hona band hua.
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): 10% speed reduction add; duration 15s se 10s, cooldown 120s se 90s; cooldown reset release ke 10s ke andar takedown tak limited.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): 9th Anniversary Skill Boosts—Camo Decoy (moving decoy, 10 DMG/10s ya human form par disappear) aur Cloned Camo (2 extra bushes, 10s).
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Cooldown 90s se 75s hua.

name: Olivia
introEn: Passive that boosts healing and shares single-target healing with nearby teammates.
introHi: Passive jo healing boost karta hai aur single-target healing paas ke teammates ke saath share karta hai.
currentEn: Increases healing effects by 30% and spreads 90% of the user's single-target healing amount to teammates within 20m.
currentHi: Healing effects 30% badhata hai aur user ki single-target healing ka 90% 20m ke andar teammates ko share karta hai.
notesEn: Built as a team healer to support nearby teammates.
notesHi: Nearby teammates ko support karne ke liye team-healer role mein designed.
historyEn: OB27 (Apr 2021): Revive bonus HP raised, maximum 40 to 70.
Jan 2022 (Illuminate): Revive bonus HP maximum 70 to 80.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Reworked: spreads 80% of single-target healing to teammates within 10m; revive role passed to Thiva.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Added +30% healing effects; spread range 10m to 15m.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Shared healing 80% to 90%, range 15m to 20m.
historyHi: OB27 (Apr 2021): Revive bonus HP maximum 40 se 70 hua.
Jan 2022 (Illuminate): Revive bonus HP maximum 70 se 80 hua.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Rework—single-target healing ka 80% 10m ke teammates ko share; revive role Thiva ko mila.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): +30% healing effects add; share range 10m se 15m.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Shared healing 80% se 90%, range 15m se 20m.

name: Shani
introEn: Passive that gives Shield Points to Shani and nearby teammates whenever she uses an active skill.
introHi: Passive jo Shani ke active skill use karne par use aur nearby teammates ko Shield Points deta hai.
currentEn: When using an active skill, gives 30 Shield Points to self and teammates within 10m. The Shield Points decay after 10 seconds, after which players can obtain the effect again.
currentHi: Active skill use karne par khud ko aur 10m ke andar teammates ko 30 Shield Points milte hain. 10 seconds baad Shield Points decay ho jaate hain, phir effect dobara mil sakta hai.
notesEn: Shield Points are deducted before HP. Shield Points ignore armor damage-reduction buffs. Shield Points do not protect against Danger Zone, fall or bleeding damage.
notesHi: Shield Points HP se pehle deduct hote hain. Ye armor damage-reduction buffs ko ignore karte hain. Danger Zone, fall ya bleeding damage se protection nahi dete.
historyEn: OB41 (Aug 2023): Reworked: 50 Shield Points, decay after 5s, cooldown 10s.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): 50 to 40 Shield Points.

introEn: Passive that restores HP over time after Ford takes damage.
introHi: Passive jo Ford ko damage lene ke baad time ke saath HP restore karta hai.

currentHi: Damage lene par 3 seconds tak 10 HP/s milta hai. Ford active skill release karte hi skill turant reset ho jata hai.

OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Duration 3s to 4s.

historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): Damage lene par HP restore rework—3s ke liye 10 HP/s, cooldown 20s; Danger Zone survivability kam hui.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Duration 3s se 4s hua.
OB51 (Oct 2025): Duration 4s se 3s hua.

name: K
introEn: Active skill that switches between EP-conversion support and personal EP recovery modes.
introHi: Active skill jo EP-conversion support aur khud EP recover karne ke modes ke beech switch karta hai.

currentHi: Master of All Max EP ko 50 badhata hai. Jiu-jitsu Mode mein 15m ke andar allies ka EP conversion 600% badhta hai. Psychology Mode mein har 1s par 3 EP recover hota hai, maximum 250 EP tak.

historyHi: OB46 (4 Sep 2024): Jiu-jitsu ally range 6m se 15m; Psychology recovery interval 2s se 1s; mode-switch cooldown 3s se 6s hua. Max EP +50, conversion boost 600%, recovery cap 250 EP.

name: Sonia
introEn: Passive survival skill that briefly protects Sonia after fatal damage, then requires a knockdown before its shield expires.
introHi: Passive survival skill jo fatal damage ke baad Sonia ko thodi der protect karta hai; shield khatam hone se pehle knockdown zaroori hai.
currentEn: After fatal damage, Sonia enters an invulnerable and immobile state for 0.4s, then gains a 1 HP shield for 2s. Sonia is eliminated when the shield disappears.
currentHi: Fatal damage ke baad Sonia 0.4s invulnerable aur immobile hoti hai, phir 2s ke liye 1 HP shield milta hai. Shield khatam hote hi Sonia eliminate ho jaati hai.
notesEn: The OB50 notes specify elimination when the shield disappears; no successful knockdown rescue condition remains in the current profile. Garena does not publish a different outcome if the shield is depleted early.
notesHi: OB50 notes ke mutabik shield disappear hote hi elimination hota hai; current profile mein knockdown se bachne wali condition nahi hai. Shield jaldi deplete ho toh exact outcome Garena publish nahi karta.
historyEn: OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Shield reduced 150 HP → 100 HP.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Revival feature removed; 0.5s → 0.4s invulnerability and shield duration 3s → 2s; shield 100 HP → 50 HP.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Shield 50 HP → 1 HP; user is eliminated when shield disappears.
historyHi: OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Shield 150 HP se 100 HP hua.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Revival feature remove; invulnerability 0.5s se 0.4s, shield duration 3s se 2s aur shield 100 HP se 50 HP hua.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Shield 50 HP se 1 HP; shield disappear hote hi elimination.

name: Orion
introEn: Active defensive skill that consumes Crimson Energy to grant temporary protection and drain nearby enemies' HP.
introHi: Active defensive skill jo Crimson Energy consume karke temporary protection deta hai aur paas ke enemies ki HP absorb karta hai.

currentHi: EP ki jagah 300 Crimson Energy milti hai. 200 energy consume karke 3s protection activate hota hai; Orion damage nahi le sakta aur attack nahi kar sakta, aur 5m ke enemies se 10 HP absorb karta hai (enemy Shield Points ignore). Movement speed 10% kam hoti hai. Cooldown 3s.
notesEn: Protection prevents damage and attacking while active. HP absorption ignores enemy Shield Points.
notesHi: Protection active hone par damage aur attacking dono unavailable hote hain. HP absorption enemy Shield Points ko ignore karta hai.
historyEn: OB46 (4 Sep 2024): Movement-speed penalty reduced 20% → 10%.
historyHi: OB46 (4 Sep 2024): Movement-speed penalty 20% se 10% hui.

name: Santino
introEn: Active mobility skill that deploys a moving mannequin and allows limited position swaps with it.
introHi: Active mobility skill jo moving mannequin deploy karta hai aur uske saath limited position swap allow karta hai.

The player who destroys the mannequin is marked for 5s. Teleport is prohibited if mannequin is 10m higher than Santino. Cooldown: 60s.
currentHi: 200 HP mannequin 25s tak khud move karta hai. 90m ke andar ho toh skill dobara use karke position swap kar sakte hain; total 2 swaps, aur 3s ke andar sirf ek swap. Mannequin destroy karne wala player 5s mark hota hai. Mannequin Santino se 10m zyada upar ho toh teleport allowed nahi. Cooldown 60s.

rows.value: No teleport if mannequin is 10m higher

notesEn: OB50 added the 10m vertical restriction. Garena does not publish a separate exact movement speed for the mannequin.
notesHi: OB50 mein 10m vertical restriction add hui. Mannequin ki exact movement speed Garena publish nahi karta.
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): Mannequin changed from stationary to autonomous movement; cooldown 80s.
OB44 (16 Apr 2024): Mannequin duration 12s → 25s; cooldown 75s → 60s; swap limit set to 2 and 3s spacing; mark destroyer for 5s.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Mannequin range 60m → 90m; vertical restriction added (no teleport if mannequin is 10m higher).

historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): Mannequin stationary se autonomous movement hua; cooldown 80s.
OB44 (16 Apr 2024): Duration 12s se 25s; cooldown 75s se 60s; 2 swaps/3s spacing aur destroyer mark 5s.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Mannequin range 60m se 90m; 10m higher hone par teleport restriction add.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Mannequin ke small collision volume ka bug fix hua, jisse players unintended areas mein ja sakte, stuck ho sakte ya glitch exploit kar sakte the (bug fix; skill stat change nahi).

name: Tatsuya
introEn: Active mobility skill that dashes forward and refreshes its cooldown after a timely knockdown.
introHi: Active mobility skill jo forward dash karta hai aur timely knockdown par cooldown reset hota hai.
currentEn: Rushes forward quickly for 0.3s. Knocking down an enemy within 10s after skill release resets Rebel Rush's cooldown. If no qualifying knockdown occurs, cooldown is 90s.
currentHi: 0.3s ke liye rapid forward dash karta hai. Skill release ke 10s ke andar enemy knock karne par Rebel Rush ka cooldown reset hota hai. Qualifying knockdown na ho toh cooldown 90s.
notesEn: Cooldown reset is conditional, not an automatic reset on every knockdown: the knockdown must occur within 10s after releasing the skill. Garena does not publish a limit on repeated qualifying resets during a match.
notesHi: Cooldown har knockdown par automatically reset nahi hota: skill release ke 10s ke andar knockdown hona zaroori hai. Match mein repeated qualifying resets ki limit Garena publish nahi karta.
historyEn: OB43 (19 Feb 2024): Stored charges 3 → 2 (older mechanic).
OB44 (16 Apr 2024): Dash replenishment 45s → 60s (older mechanic).
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Cooldown between uses 1s → 5s (older mechanic).

historyHi: OB43 (19 Feb 2024): Stored charges 3 se 2 (old mechanic).
OB44 (16 Apr 2024): Dash replenishment 45s se 60s (old mechanic).
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Uses ke beech cooldown 1s se 5s (old mechanic).
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): Har knockdown par reset se badal kar skill release ke 10s ke andar knockdown par reset; base cooldown 120s se 90s.

name: Luna
introEn: Passive that boosts rate of fire and converts part of it into movement speed after Luna lands a hit.
introHi: Luna ki Passive Skill, enemy ko hit lagne ke baad Rate of Fire ka kuch hissa Movement Speed mein convert kar deti hai.

currentHi: Rate of Fire 5% badh jata hai. Luna jab kisi enemy ko hit karti hai, toh uske Rate of Fire ka maximum 10% Movement Speed mein convert ho jata hai. Combat se bachkar nikalne par yeh conversion reset ho jata hai.

rows.value: Up to 10% of rate of fire
Landing a hit on an enemy

notesEn: Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it (OB54).
notesHi: Movement Speed ki ek global maximum limit hoti hai. Skills, items aur events se milne wale bonuses is limit ko cross nahi kar sakte (OB54).
historyEn: OB36 (Sep 2022): Introduced.
Before OB49: rate of fire +8%, up to 15% converted to movement speed.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Maximum conversion 15% to 10%.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Rate of fire bonus 8% to 5%.
historyHi: OB36 (Sep 2022): Skill introduce hui.
OB49 se pehle: Rate of Fire +8% tha aur maximum 15% Movement Speed mein convert hota tha.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Maximum conversion 15% se 10% kar diya gaya.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Rate of Fire bonus 8% se 5% kar diya gaya.

name: Iris
introEn: Active skill that marks enemies behind Gloo Walls and lets Iris damage them through the walls.
introHi: Iris ki Active Skill Gloo Wall ke peeche chhupe enemies ko mark karti hai aur unhe wall ke paar se damage dene deti hai.
currentEn: For 15 seconds, successfully firing at a Gloo Wall marks enemies within 7m of it and penetrates the Gloo Wall to damage the marked enemies, with lower damage than usual. Works on up to 3 Gloo Walls.
currentHi: 15 seconds tak, Gloo Wall par successfully fire karne se uske 7m ke andar ke enemies mark ho jate hain. Phir bullets Gloo Wall ko penetrate karke marked enemies ko damage deti hain, lekin normal se kam damage hota hai. Yeh maximum 3 Gloo Walls par kaam karti hai.
notesEn: Garena does not publish the reduced damage value.
Attacks that penetrate Gloo Walls, like Iris's skill, show a clearer hit effect on the walls (OB49).
notesHi: Garena reduced damage ki exact value publish nahi karta.
Iris ki skill jaisi Gloo Wall penetrate karne wali attacks mein wall par hit effect zyada clearly dikhta hai (OB49).
historyEn: OB35 (2022): Introduced.
OB38 (Jan 2023): Skill duration increased.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Gloo Walls affected 5 to 3.
OB43 (24 Jan 2024): Fixed a damage bug when the skill penetrates Gloo Walls.

historyHi: OB35 (2022): Skill introduce hui.
OB38 (Jan 2023): Skill ki duration badhai gayi.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Affected Gloo Walls 5 se 3 kar di gayi.
OB43 (24 Jan 2024): Skill ke Gloo Wall penetrate karne par damage se juda bug fix hua.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Gloo Wall par hit hone ka visual effect zyada clear kiya gaya.

name: J.Biebs
introEn: Passive that lets J.Biebs and nearby allies block damage using EP, with allies' EP flowing to J.Biebs.

currentEn: J.Biebs and allies within 15m can block 8% of damage using EP. The EP deducted from allies is added to J.Biebs's EP.
currentHi: J.Biebs se 15m ke andar maujood woh aur uske teammates EP ka use karke 8% damage block kar sakte hain. Teammates se deduct hua EP, J.Biebs ke EP mein add ho jata hai.

historyHi: OB38 (Jan 2023): Sabhi ranks ke liye range 12m fix ki gayi (pehle 6m se 12m thi); maximum damage block 15% se 12% hua.
OB45 (Jun 2024): Range 12m se 15m aur damage block 12% se 8% kar diya gaya.

name: Homer
introEn: Active drone that locks onto the nearest enemy and slows them with a pulse explosion.

currentHi: Homer saamne 100m ke andar sabse nazdeek enemy ki taraf drone bhejta hai. Drone 5m diameter ka pulse explosion banati hai, jo 5 seconds tak enemies ki Movement Speed aur Rate of Fire 40% kam kar deti hai aur 25 DMG deti hai.
notesEn: The drone triggers Moco's tagging skill (OB40).
Once the drone locks a target, obstacles do not block it (OB43).
Joseph is immune to Homer's drone (OB42).
A voice notification plays when no enemy is detected (OB49).
notesHi: Drone, Moco ki tagging skill trigger karti hai (OB40).
Drone ke target ko lock karne ke baad obstacles use rok nahi sakte (OB43).
Joseph, Homer ki drone se immune hai (OB42).
Enemy detect na hone par voice notification sunai deta hai (OB49).

name: Kenta
introEn: Active skill that sends a tempest through Gloo Walls, then teleports Kenta to it with a short shield.
introHi: Kenta ki Active Skill Gloo Walls ke paar Tempest bhejti hai. Uske baad Kenta us jagah teleport karke thodi der ke liye shield pa leta hai.

While the tempest is active, tap the skill again to teleport to its location and gain a shield for 5 seconds with 20% damage reduction. The tempest disappears after teleporting.
currentHi: Kenta ek fast-moving, ghoomti hui Tempest release karta hai, jo Gloo Walls ke paar ja sakti hai aur 8 seconds tak rehti hai. Iski range mein aane wale enemies ko 25 DMG hota hai. Tempest active rehte hue skill ko dobara tap karke Kenta uski location par teleport kar sakta hai aur 5 seconds ke liye 20% damage reduction wala shield pa leta hai. Teleport ke baad Tempest gayab ho jati hai.

rows.value: Tap the skill again to teleport to the tempest

notesEn: OB55 replaced Kenta's original shield skill completely.
notesHi: OB55 mein Kenta ki purani shield skill ko poori tarah replace kar diya gaya.

OB38 (Jan 2023): Shield can be picked back up after firing, 10% reduction while firing, cooldown 120-70s.

historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Swordsman's Wrath ke saath introduce hua—saamne 5m shield, 50% weapon damage reduction, 2–5s duration aur 210–160s cooldown.
OB38 (Jan 2023): Fire karne ke baad shield dobara pick kiya ja sakta tha; fire karte waqt 10% reduction aur 120–70s cooldown kiya gaya.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Skill ko poori tarah rework karke Tempest aur Teleport mein badal diya gaya.

name: Nairi
introEn: Passive ability that restores deployed Gloo Wall durability and provides limited HP recovery to nearby teammates.
introHi: Passive ability jo lagayi hui Gloo Wall ki durability wapas badhati hai aur paas ke teammates ko thodi HP wapas deti hai.

Teammates within 5m recover 5 HP per second during the effect window.
currentHi: Gloo Wall lagane ke baad 1.5 seconds tak har second uski 160 durability wapas badhti hai.
5m ke andar teammates ko is 1.5-second effect ke dauran har second 5 HP wapas milti hai.

rows.hi: Gloo Wall ki durability wapas badhne ki speed
Gloo Wall lagane ke baad effect kitni der rehta hai
Paas ke teammate ko har second kitni HP milti hai
Teammate kitni door tak ho sakta hai
Dobara use karne se pehle ka wait time

OB42 stated a maximum of 40 HP per teammate per Gloo Wall; later patch notes do not explicitly reconfirm whether that cap remains.
Garena does not publish a current maximum HP recovery total per teammate per Gloo Wall.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.

OB42 mein har Gloo Wall par ek teammate ko maximum 40 HP milne ka zikr tha; baad ke patch notes confirm nahi karte ki yeh limit ab bhi hai ya nahi.

OB47 (02 Dec 2024): The post-deployment effect window changed from 3s to 2s.

historyHi: OB36 (21 Sep 2022): Har second Gloo Wall ki durability wapas badhne ki speed, current durability ke 20/22/24/26/28/30% se badhkar 40/42/44/46/48/50% hui.

OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Ice Iron ke mutabik hit hone par lagayi hui Gloo Wall 250 durability/s ki speed se repair hoti thi; 5m ke andar teammates ko 20 HP/s milti thi. Har wall par ek teammate ke liye 40 HP ki limit thi.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Gloo Wall ki repair speed 250 se 150 durability per second hui.

tacticalEn: For a planned hold or rotation, deploy the Gloo Wall at the cover point your squad intends to use so its short restoration window begins while the team stabilizes.
Keep teammates within 5m during the brief HP-recovery window; call the regroup before spreading into separate angles.
Treat Ice Iron as a short support window, not sustained healing. Time the wall deployment around the squad's move rather than relying on repeated walls to stack recovery.
tacticalHi: Squad ko kisi jagah hold karna ho ya zone ki taraf move karna ho, toh Gloo Wall us cover point par pehle lagao jahan team ko rukna hai. Isse repair ka short effect sahi time par milega.
Jab 1.5-second HP recovery chal rahi ho, teammates ko 5m ke andar rakho. Alag angles lene se pehle squad ko paas aane ka call do.
Ice Iron ko short support effect samjho, lagataar healing nahi. Gloo Wall lagane ka time squad ki movement ke saath match karo; multiple walls se HP effect stack nahi hota.
strengthsEn: Adds a short durability-restoration window to deployed Gloo Walls, helping the squad maintain temporary cover.
Provides nearby teammates with a small HP-recovery window when they stay within 5m.
strengthsHi: Gloo Wall lagane ke baad kuch pal ke liye uski durability wapas badhti hai, jisse squad temporary cover ko zyada der hold kar sakti hai.
5m ke andar teammates ko thodi HP wapas milti hai.
limitationsEn: The post-deployment effect window is only 1.5 seconds, so timing matters.
The teammate-healing effect does not stack from deploying multiple Gloo Walls.
Garena does not publish a current per-wall maximum HP recovery total for each teammate.
limitationsHi: Gloo Wall lagane ke baad effect sirf 1.5 seconds rehta hai, isliye sahi timing zaroori hai.
Ek se zyada Gloo Walls lagane par teammate ki HP recovery add nahi hoti.
Har teammate ko ek Gloo Wall se total kitni maximum HP mil sakti hai, Garena abhi nahi batata.

Marked enemies have their movement speed reduced by 25% for 3 seconds.
If Otho is knocked down by a nearby enemy, Memory Mist marks and slows the attacker and their teammates.

Mark hue enemies ki movement speed 3 seconds ke liye 25% kam ho jaati hai.
Agar koi paas ka enemy Otho ko knockdown karta hai, toh Memory Mist us attacker aur uske teammates ko mark karke unki speed kam karti hai.

Memory Mist ek baar mein maximum kitne players ko mark kar sakti hai, Garena nahi batata.

3-second slow se squad ko thoda time milta hai. Is dauran position badalne, better angle lene ya safe jagah par reset karne ka call do.

strengthsEn: A knockdown can reveal the downed enemy's nearby teammates, giving the squad information for its next decision.
The 25% movement-speed reduction can briefly disrupt an enemy group's reposition.
The self-knockdown trigger can also mark and slow the nearby attacker and their teammates.
strengthsHi: Enemy knockdown hone par uske paas chhupe teammates ki location pata chal sakti hai, jisse squad ko next move decide karne mein help milti hai.
25% slow hone se enemy group kuch seconds ke liye jaldi position change nahi kar paata.
Otho khud knockdown ho, tab bhi paas ka attacker aur uske teammates mark hote hain aur unki speed kam hoti hai.
limitationsEn: The main trigger requires Otho to knock down an enemy; it is not a continuous scan.
The published 20m range is measured from the knocked-down enemy. Garena does not publish a separate numeric range for the self-knockdown trigger.
The mark-and-slow effect lasts only 3 seconds, and Garena does not publish a maximum mark count.
limitationsHi: Main effect tabhi chalta hai jab Otho kisi enemy ko knockdown kare; yeh har waqt enemies ko scan nahi karta.
20m ki range downed enemy se gini jaati hai. Otho khud knockdown ho toh us case ki exact range Garena nahi batata.
Mark aur slow ka effect sirf 3 seconds rehta hai. Ek baar mein maximum kitne enemies mark honge, yeh bhi clear nahi hai.

name: Leon
introEn: Passive ability that restores HP after Leon survives combat.
introHi: Passive ability jo fight se bachkar nikalne ke baad Leon ki HP dheere-dheere wapas badhati hai.
currentEn: After surviving combat, Leon recovers 60 HP at a rate of 4 HP per second for 15 seconds.
currentHi: Fight se bachkar nikalne ke baad Leon ko 15 seconds tak har second 4 HP wapas milti hai. Is tarah total 60 HP recover hoti hai.

rows.hi: Total kitni HP wapas milti hai
Har second kitni HP milti hai
Dobara use karne se pehle ka wait time

notesEn: The recovery begins after the game registers that Leon has survived combat.
Garena does not publish the exact combat-disengagement timer that determines when the recovery trigger begins.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: Game jab confirm kar leta hai ki Leon fight se bachkar nikal gaya hai, tab HP wapas milna shuru hoti hai.
Fight khatam hone ke kitni der baad recovery shuru hogi, iska exact timer Garena nahi batata.
Is passive ability ka exact cooldown Garena nahi batata.
historyEn: OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Maximum recovery increased from 30 HP to 60 HP; recovery rate changed from 5 to 4 HP/s; maximum recovery duration changed from 6s to 15s.
historyHi: OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Total HP recovery 30 se 60 hui; har second milne wali HP 5 se 4 hui; recovery ka maximum time 6s se 15s hua.

source.label: Garena — Official Leon full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: After an engagement ends, create space behind cover and let Buzzer Beater's recovery tick before taking another contested position.
Use the recovery window to regroup with teammates and prepare the next rotation instead of treating the passive as an emergency instant heal.
Call out when you are disengaging so the squad can avoid leaving Leon isolated while the recovery is taking effect.
tacticalHi: Fight khatam hone par cover ke peeche jao aur next risky position lene se pehle Buzzer Beater se HP wapas aane do.
HP recovery ke in 15 seconds ka use teammates ke saath dobara group banane aur next zone move plan karne mein karo. Ise instant heal mat samjho.
Fight se peeche hatte waqt squad ko call do, taaki HP wapas aate samay Leon akela na reh jaaye.
strengthsEn: Provides up to 60 HP of recovery after surviving combat without requiring a manual activation.
The 15-second recovery window can support a reset between engagements.
strengthsHi: Fight se bachne ke baad bina button dabaye total 60 HP wapas milti hai.
15 seconds ka recovery time do fights ke beech squad ke saath dobara ready hone mein help karta hai.
limitationsEn: Recovery is gradual at 4 HP/s, not an instant HP burst.
The trigger is tied to surviving combat; Garena does not publish the exact disengagement timer.
It does not replace cover or teammate support during an active engagement.
limitationsHi: HP ek saath nahi milti; har second sirf 4 HP wapas aati hai.
Ability fight se safely bahar aane ke baad hi shuru hoti hai; exact timer Garena nahi batata.
Fight chal rahi ho, toh yeh cover ya teammate support ki jagah nahi le sakti.

name: Koda
introEn: Active ability that activates an aurora effect, increases movement speed and periodically reveals enemies behind cover.
introHi: Active ability jo Aurora effect chalu karti hai, movement speed badhati hai aur cover ke peeche maujood enemies ki location baar-baar dikhati hai.
currentEn: Activates the Aurora power for 8 seconds and increases movement speed by 15%.
Reveals enemies behind cover within 50m every 1 second; crouching or prone enemies cannot be detected.
While parachuting, highlights enemy locations within the field of view, but the effect is not shared with teammates.
currentHi: Aurora power 8 seconds ke liye chalu hoti hai aur movement speed 15% badhati hai.
50m ke andar cover ke peeche maujood enemies ki location har 1 second mein dikhati hai. Jhuk kar ya letkar chalne wale enemies detect nahi hote.
Parachute se utarte waqt saamne nazar aa rahe area ke enemies ki location highlight hoti hai, lekin yeh information teammates ko automatically nahi dikhti.

rows.hi: Aurora effect kitni der rehta hai
Location kitni der mein dobara check hoti hai
Jhuk kar / letkar chalne wale enemies
Dobara use karne se pehle ka wait time

notesEn: The parachuting highlight is visible only to Koda's user.

OB54 lists two optional BR Skill Boosts, separate from the base Aurora Vision values: Synced Vision marks enemies revealed during the first detection interval for 3 seconds and shares the information with teammates; Imprinted Vision applies up to 3 stacks, with 10 additional DMG per stack when the imprints are activated by an attack.
Only one of the two Skill Boost options can be selected. OB54 did not change the base duration, movement-speed bonus, detection range or cooldown.
notesHi: Parachuting ke waqt enemy location ka highlight sirf Koda use karne wale player ko dikhta hai.

OB54 mein base Aurora Vision se alag do optional BR Skill Boosts diye gaye hain: Synced Vision pehli scan mein mile enemies ko 3 seconds ke liye mark karta hai aur unki information teammates ko bhi deta hai. Imprinted Vision maximum 3 stacks lagata hai; attack karne par har stack 10 extra DMG deta hai.
Dono Skill Boosts mein se ek hi choose kar sakte ho. OB54 ne base ability ka duration, movement-speed bonus, detection range ya cooldown nahi badla.
historyEn: OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Koda introduced with a 10s Aurora duration, +10% movement speed, 50m detection every 1s, a 60s cooldown, and a parachuting highlight not shared with teammates.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Movement-speed bonus increased from 10% to 15%; cooldown reduced from 60s to 45s.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Aurora duration reduced from 10s to 8s.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Two optional BR Skill Boosts were listed again: Synced Vision (3s shared mark) and Imprinted Vision (up to 3 stacks; 10 DMG per stack when activated).
historyHi: OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Koda launch hua: Aurora 10s tak rehta tha, movement speed +10% thi, 50m range mein har 1s enemy location dikhata tha, cooldown 60s tha. Parachuting highlight teammates ko share nahi hota tha.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Movement-speed bonus 10% se 15% hua; cooldown 60s se 45s hua.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Aurora ka time 10s se 8s hua.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Do optional BR Skill Boosts phir list hue: Synced Vision (3s ke liye shared mark) aur Imprinted Vision (maximum 3 stacks; activate hone par har stack 10 DMG deta hai).

source.label: Garena — Official Koda full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: Activate Aurora Vision before entering a contested rotation or checking likely enemy cover, then share each reveal with the squad through clear callouts.
Use the 15% movement-speed bonus to reposition with teammates while the detection window is active; do not assume every enemy will be revealed.
During parachuting, use the personal field-of-view highlights to call out visible locations because that information is not shared automatically with teammates.
tacticalHi: Enemy cover check karne ya zone ki taraf risky route lene se pehle Aurora Vision chalu karo. Jo enemy location dikhe, uski clear callout squad ko do.
Scan chalte waqt 15% movement-speed bonus ka use teammates ke saath position badalne mein karo. Yeh mat samjho ki har enemy zaroor detect hoga.
Parachuting ke waqt jo enemy locations tumhe highlight dikhein, unhe voice chat par call karo, kyunki teammates ko yeh highlight apne aap nahi dikhta.
strengthsEn: Periodically reveals enemies behind cover within 50m, excluding crouching and prone targets.
Adds a 15% movement-speed bonus during the 8-second Aurora window.
Can highlight visible enemy locations during parachuting for the user.
strengthsHi: 50m ke andar cover ke peeche maujood enemies ki location baar-baar dikha sakta hai. Jhuk kar ya letkar chalne wale enemies detect nahi hote.
8-second Aurora effect ke dauran 15% movement-speed bonus milta hai.
Parachuting ke waqt Koda use karne wale player ko saamne dikh rahe enemies ki location highlight ho sakti hai.
limitationsEn: The active window lasts 8 seconds and the cooldown is 45 seconds.
Crouching and prone enemies cannot be detected by the behind-cover scan.
Parachuting highlights are not shared with teammates.
OB54 Skill Boosts are optional BR enhancements and are separate from the base Aurora Vision values.
limitationsHi: Active effect sirf 8 seconds rehta hai aur cooldown 45 seconds hai.
Cover ke peeche scan jhuk kar ya letkar chalne wale enemies ko nahi pakadta.
Parachuting ke waqt milne wala highlight teammates ko share nahi hota.
OB54 Skill Boosts optional BR upgrades hain; yeh base Aurora Vision ability se alag hain.

name: Thiva
introEn: Passive support ability that speeds up teammate help-ups and restores HP to the teammate who is successfully helped up.
introHi: Passive support ability jo teammate ko revive karne ki speed badhati hai. Revive successful hone par us teammate ko extra HP bhi milti hai.
currentEn: The speed of helping up teammates is increased by 70%.
After a successful help-up, the helped-up teammate recovers 60 HP over 3 seconds.
currentHi: Teammate ko revive karne ki speed 70% badh jaati hai.
Revive successful hone ke baad us teammate ko 3 seconds mein total 60 HP wapas milti hai.

rows.hi: Teammate ko revive karne ki speed
Revive ke baad teammate ko milne wali HP
Dobara effect milne se pehle ka wait time

notesEn: The HP recovery is applied to the teammate who was successfully helped up.
notesHi: Extra HP usi teammate ko milti hai jiska revive successfully complete hua ho.
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum help-up speed increased from 25% to 30%; HP recovery after a successful rescue increased from 40 HP to 50 HP over 5s.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Vital Vibes reworked to +70% help-up speed, 60s cooldown and 100 HP recovered by the helped-up teammate over 3s.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown increased from 60s to 90s; helped-up teammate recovery reduced from 100 HP to 60 HP over 3s.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Teammate ko revive karne ki maximum speed 25% se 30% hui; successful revive ke baad HP 5s mein 40 se 50 hui.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Vital Vibes ability badli: revive speed +70%, cooldown 60s aur revive hue teammate ko 3s mein 100 HP milti thi.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown 60s se 90s hua; revive hue teammate ki HP 3s mein 100 se 60 hui.

source.label: Garena — Official Thiva full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: Prioritize a safe help-up behind cover when a teammate is downed; Thiva's 70% faster help-up speed shortens the time the squad must stay committed to the rescue.
After a successful help-up, keep the rescued teammate with the squad while the 60 HP recovery is applied over 3 seconds.
Track the 90-second cooldown and coordinate the next rescue window rather than assuming Vital Vibes is always available.
tacticalHi: Teammate knockdown ho jaaye, toh pehle cover ke peeche safe revive do. Thiva ki 70% faster revive speed se team ko revive karne mein kam time lagta hai.
Revive complete hone ke baad us teammate ko squad ke paas rakho, taaki 3 seconds mein milne wali 60 HP ka benefit use kar sake.
90-second cooldown yaad rakho aur next revive ke liye teammates ke saath timing set karo. Vital Vibes har waqt ready nahi hota.
strengthsEn: Increases teammate help-up speed by 70%, reducing the time needed to complete a rescue.
The successfully helped-up teammate receives 60 HP over 3 seconds.
strengthsHi: Teammate ko revive karne ki speed 70% badh jaati hai, isliye revive jaldi complete hota hai.
Successful revive ke baad us teammate ko 3 seconds mein 60 HP wapas milti hai.
limitationsEn: The ability has a 90-second cooldown.
The 60 HP recovery applies only after a successful help-up.
It does not provide a direct benefit while all teammates are already standing.
limitationsHi: Ability ka cooldown 90 seconds hai.
60 HP tabhi milti hai jab teammate ka revive successfully complete ho.
Jab koi teammate down nahi hai, tab is ability se direct benefit nahi milta.

name: Dimitri
introEn: Active healing zone that restores HP to Dimitri and nearby allies, and automatically starts self-recovery for downed players inside it.
introHi: Active healing zone jo Dimitri aur paas ke teammates ki HP recover karta hai, aur zone ke andar knockdown player ka self-recovery automatically start karta hai.
currentEn: Creates a healing zone with a 3.5m radius.
Dimitri and allies inside the zone recover 10 HP per second.
When Dimitri or an ally is downed inside the zone, self-recovery automatically starts when needed.
The zone lasts 12 seconds. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
currentHi: 3.5m radius ka healing zone banta hai.
Zone ke andar Dimitri aur teammates ko har second 10 HP recover hoti hai.
Zone ke andar Dimitri ya teammate knockdown ho, toh zaroorat padne par self-recovery automatically start hota hai.
Zone 12 seconds tak rehta hai. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
notesEn: OB40 states that the help-up effect can be enhanced by other skills.
During self-recovery, players can move and no longer lose HP (OB34).
Garena does not publish a separate maximum number of self-recovery activations within one zone.
notesHi: OB40 ke mutabik, help-up effect ko doosri skills se enhance kiya ja sakta hai.
Self-recovery ke dauran player move kar sakta hai aur HP lose nahi hoti (OB34).
Garena ek zone ke andar self-recovery kitni baar activate ho sakta hai, iska maximum number publish nahi karta.
historyEn: 4th Anniversary (04 Aug 2021): Introduced Healing Heartbeat — 3.5m healing zone, 3 HP/s, up to 15s duration and 60s cooldown at maximum level; downed users and allies could self-recover.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Self-recovery was improved so players could move during it without losing HP.
OB37 (21 Sep 2022): HP recovery increased from 3 to 5 HP/s.
OB40 (30 May 2023): HP recovery increased from 5 to 10 HP/s; downed players inside the zone automatically began self-recovery when needed; zone duration became 12s and cooldown was 60s.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown increased from 60s to 90s.
historyHi: 4th Anniversary (04 Aug 2021): Healing Heartbeat introduce hua — 3.5m healing zone, 3 HP/s, maximum level par 15s duration aur 60s cooldown; knockdown Dimitri aur teammates self-recover kar sakte the.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Self-recovery update hua; ab player recovery ke dauran move kar sakta tha aur HP lose nahi hoti thi.
OB37 (21 Sep 2022): HP recovery 3 se 5 HP/s hui.
OB40 (30 May 2023): HP recovery 5 se 10 HP/s hui; zone ke andar knockdown players ka self-recovery zaroorat padne par automatically start hua; zone duration 12s aur cooldown 60s hua.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown 60s se 90s hua.

hiddenMechanics.text: While self-recovering, the player can move and no longer loses HP (OB34).

tacticalEn: Call the healing zone before regrouping so nearby teammates know where its support area is centered.
If a teammate is downed inside the zone, communicate that self-recovery may start automatically; do not assume the area is safe from interruption.
tacticalHi: Regroup karne se pehle healing zone ki location call karo, taaki teammates ko support area ka clear idea rahe.
Zone ke andar teammate knockdown ho, toh communicate karo ki self-recovery automatically start ho sakta hai; area ko automatically safe assume mat karo.
strengthsEn: Provides HP recovery to Dimitri and nearby allies during the active zone.
Can automatically start self-recovery for downed players inside the zone.
strengthsHi: Active zone ke dauran Dimitri aur nearby teammates ko HP recovery milti hai.
Zone ke andar downed player ka self-recovery automatically start ho sakta hai.
limitationsEn: The support area is limited to a 3.5m radius and lasts 12 seconds.
The 90-second cooldown means the zone is not continuously available.
limitationsHi: Support area ka radius 3.5m hai aur zone 12 seconds tak rehta hai.
90-second cooldown ki wajah se zone continuously available nahi hota.

name: Skyler
introEn: Active sonic-wave skill that damages Gloo Walls in an area and can store up to two charges.
introHi: Active sonic-wave skill jo area mein Gloo Walls ko damage karti hai aur maximum 2 charges store kar sakti hai.
currentEn: Unleashes a sonic wave forward; OB55 states that the actual skill-effect range is over 100m, but does not publish an exact distance.
When the wave hits an obstacle, it explodes and deals 500 DMG per second to Gloo Walls within a 4m radius.
The damage effect lasts 6 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds. Up to 2 skill charges can be stored.
HP recovery is not included in the current base-skill values used here; the OB38 rework removed Skyler's healing effect.
currentHi: Aage sonic wave release hoti hai; OB55 ke mutabik actual skill-effect range 100m se zyada hai, lekin exact distance publish nahi ki gayi.
Wave kisi obstacle se hit hone par explode hoti hai aur 4m radius ke andar Gloo Walls ko har second 500 DMG deti hai.
Damage effect 6 seconds tak rehta hai. Cooldown: 45 seconds. Maximum 2 skill charges store ho sakti hain.
Current base-skill values mein HP recovery include nahi hai; OB38 rework mein Skyler ka healing effect remove kiya gaya tha.
notesEn: OB55 says the skill-effect visibility was extended to match the actual range of over 100m. Garena does not publish the exact range.

OB54 introduced two optional BR Skill Boosts: Sticky Rhythm creates a small area that follows the nearest enemy and damages Gloo Walls inside it; Split Rhythm searches for Gloo Walls within 75m, locks onto target walls for 15s and sends waves toward up to 3 walls. Exact damage values for these boosts are not published.
Only one Skill Boost option can be selected for the skill in a match.
OB47 added aim assistance toward Gloo Walls; OB49 added an obstacle indicator to the aiming line.
notesHi: OB55 mein skill-effect ki visibility ko actual 100m se zyada range ke saath match kiya gaya. Garena exact range publish nahi karta.

OB54 mein 2 optional BR Skill Boosts aaye: Sticky Rhythm ek chhota area banata hai jo nearest enemy ko follow karta hai aur uske andar ki Gloo Walls ko damage karta hai; Split Rhythm 75m ke andar Gloo Walls search karta hai, target walls ko 15s lock karta hai aur maximum 3 walls ki taraf waves bhejta hai. In boosts ka exact damage Garena publish nahi karta.
Ek match mein is skill ke liye sirf ek Skill Boost option select kiya ja sakta hai.
OB47 mein Gloo Walls ki taraf aim assistance add hui; OB49 mein aiming line par obstacle indicator add hua.
historyEn: OB34 (25 May 2022): At maximum level, cooldown increased from 40s to 60s; each deployed Gloo Wall granted HP recovery, up to 9 points, and recovery effects did not stack.
OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Reworked into area damage over time; maximum wave range 100m, 3.5m damage radius, 4s duration and 50s cooldown. HP recovery was removed.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Damage radius increased from 3.5m to 4m; duration increased from 4s to 5s; cooldown reduced from 50s to 45s.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Duration increased from 5s to 6s; cooldown reduced from 45s to 40s.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Added up to 2 stored charges; published values were 500 DMG/s within 4m for 6s, with a 45s cooldown and up to 100m wave range.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Added aim assistance toward Gloo Walls.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Added an obstacle indicator to the skill's aiming line.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Added optional BR Skill Boosts Sticky Rhythm and Split Rhythm.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Extended skill-effect visibility to match the actual range of over 100m; the exact range was not published.
historyHi: OB34 (25 May 2022): Maximum level par cooldown 40s se 60s hua; har deployed Gloo Wall par maximum 9 points tak HP recovery milti thi aur recovery stack nahi hoti thi.
OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Skill ko area damage-over-time effect mein rework kiya gaya; maximum wave range 100m, 3.5m damage radius, 4s duration aur 50s cooldown hua. HP recovery remove hui.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Damage radius 3.5m se 4m, duration 4s se 5s aur cooldown 50s se 45s hua.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Duration 5s se 6s aur cooldown 45s se 40s hua.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Maximum 2 stored charges add hui; published values 4m ke andar 500 DMG/s, 6s duration, 45s cooldown aur maximum 100m wave range the.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Gloo Walls ki taraf aim assistance add hui.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Skill ki aiming line par obstacle indicator add hua.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Optional BR Skill Boosts Sticky Rhythm aur Split Rhythm add hue.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Skill-effect visibility ko actual 100m se zyada range ke saath match kiya gaya; exact range publish nahi hui.

hiddenMechanics.text: Riptide Rhythm receives aim assistance toward Gloo Walls (OB47).
An obstacle indicator appears on the aiming line (OB49).

tacticalEn: Communicate the intended route before relying on a Gloo Wall interaction; teammates should know which area is being affected.
Treat the exact wave range as unpublished: OB55 confirms it is over 100m but gives no precise distance.
tacticalHi: Gloo Wall interaction par rely karne se pehle intended route communicate karo; teammates ko pata hona chahiye ki kaunsa area affect ho raha hai.
Wave ki exact range ko unpublished hi samjho: OB55 100m se zyada confirm karta hai, lekin precise distance nahi deta.
strengthsEn: The sonic-wave effect can affect Gloo Walls within a 4m radius for 6 seconds.
The skill can store up to two charges.
strengthsHi: Sonic-wave effect 4m radius ke andar Gloo Walls ko 6 seconds tak affect karta hai.
Skill maximum 2 charges store kar sakti hai.
limitationsEn: The exact actual range above 100m is not published by Garena.
The skill has a 45-second cooldown; stored charges do not make it continuously available.
limitationsHi: 100m se zyada actual range ka exact number Garena publish nahi karta.
Skill ka cooldown 45 seconds hai; stored charges ka matlab continuous availability nahi hai.

name: Xayne
introEn: Active skill that grants temporary Shield Points, which refill and refresh the skill duration when Xayne knocks down an enemy.
introHi: Active skill jo temporary Shield Points deti hai; Xayne enemy ko knockdown kare toh shield refill hota hai aur skill ka timer reset hota hai.
currentEn: Enters the Xtreme state and instantly gains 70 temporary Shield Points for 15 seconds.
Each enemy knockdown during the state restores the temporary Shield Points from this skill back to 70 and resets the state duration.
When the state ends, the Shield Points gained through this skill are removed. Cooldown: 75 seconds.
currentHi: Xtreme state activate hoti hai aur turant 70 temporary Shield Points milte hain, jo 15 seconds tak rehte hain.
State ke dauran har enemy knockdown par is skill ke temporary Shield Points wapas 70 ho jaate hain aur state ka timer reset hota hai.
State khatam hote hi is skill se mile Shield Points remove ho jaate hain. Cooldown: 75 seconds.

rows.value: Garena does not publish this value

notesEn: The temporary Shield Points from Xtreme Encounter are removed when the state ends; they are not permanent HP.
Each enemy knockdown during the active state restores this skill's temporary Shield Points to 70 and resets the duration.
Garena does not publish a maximum number of duration refreshes.
notesHi: Xtreme Encounter ke temporary Shield Points state khatam hone par remove ho jaate hain; yeh permanent HP nahi hain.
Active state ke dauran har enemy knockdown par is skill ke temporary Shield Points 70 ho jaate hain aur duration reset hoti hai.
Garena duration kitni baar maximum refresh ho sakti hai, yeh publish nahi karta.
historyEn: Patch Note: World Series (14 Apr 2021): Introduced with 80 temporary HP, up to 100% increased damage to Gloo Walls and shields, 10s duration and 100s cooldown at maximum level.
Illuminate (19 Jan 2022): Maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus increased from 100% to 130%; duration increased from 10s to 15s. Maximum cooldown remained 100s.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Temporary HP increased from 80 to 120; maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus increased from 130% to 200%; duration reduced from 15s to 6s.
OB46 (01 Sep 2024): Reworked from temporary HP to 60 temporary Shield Points for 12s; each enemy knockdown restored the shield to 60 and reset duration; cooldown became 75s.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Temporary Shield Points reduced from 60 to 50; duration remained 12s and cooldown remained 75s.
OB52 (09 Jan 2026): Temporary Shield Points increased from 50 to 70 and duration increased from 12s to 15s; cooldown remained 75s.
historyHi: Patch Note: World Series (14 Apr 2021): 80 temporary HP, maximum level par Gloo Walls aur shields ko 100% extra damage, 10s duration aur 100s cooldown ke saath introduce hui.
Illuminate (19 Jan 2022): Maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus 100% se 130% hua; duration 10s se 15s hui. Maximum cooldown 100s hi raha.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Temporary HP 80 se 120 hui; maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus 130% se 200% hua; duration 15s se 6s hui.
OB46 (01 Sep 2024): Temporary HP ki jagah 12s ke liye 60 temporary Shield Points mile; har enemy knockdown par shield 60 tak refill hota aur duration reset hoti; cooldown 75s hua.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Temporary Shield Points 60 se 50 hue; duration 12s aur cooldown 75s hi rahe.
OB52 (09 Jan 2026): Temporary Shield Points 50 se 70 hue aur duration 12s se 15s hui; cooldown 75s hi raha.
tacticalEn: Tell teammates when the temporary Shield Point state begins and when it expires so they do not mistake it for permanent protection.
A knockdown during the active state refreshes the Shield Points and duration; the profile does not assume a maximum refresh count.
tacticalHi: Temporary Shield Point state kab start aur expire hoti hai, teammates ko communicate karo; ise permanent protection mat samjho.
Active state ke dauran knockdown hone par Shield Points aur duration refresh hote hain; profile koi maximum refresh count assume nahi karti.
strengthsEn: Grants 70 temporary Shield Points for a 15-second state.
Each enemy knockdown during the state restores the skill's Shield Points to 70 and resets the duration.
strengthsHi: 15-second state ke liye 70 temporary Shield Points milte hain.
State ke dauran har enemy knockdown par skill ke Shield Points 70 ho jaate hain aur duration reset hoti hai.
limitationsEn: Shield Points gained from the skill are removed when the state ends.
The cooldown is 75 seconds, and Garena does not publish a maximum refresh count.
limitationsHi: Skill se mile Shield Points state khatam hone par remove ho jaate hain.
Cooldown 75 seconds hai, aur Garena maximum refresh count publish nahi karta.

name: Lila
introEn: Passive that decelerates enemies and vehicles shot with rifles, freezing them and generating Gloo Walls upon knockdown.
introHi: Passive that decelerates enemies and vehicles shot with rifles, freezing them and generating Gloo Walls upon knockdown.
currentEn: When hitting enemies or vehicles with rifles or marksman rifles, reduces the enemies' movement speed by 10% or the vehicles' acceleration by 80% for 3 seconds. If the enemy is knocked down while decelerated, freezes them for up to 3 seconds and obtains 2 extra Gloo Walls.
currentHi: When hitting enemies or vehicles with rifles or marksman rifles, reduces the enemies' movement speed by 10% or the vehicles' acceleration by 80% for 3 seconds. If the enemy is knocked down while decelerated, freezes them for up to 3 seconds and obtains 2 extra Gloo Walls.
notesEn: The OB47 patch removed the original 10-second cooldown, making the skill continuously active upon landing successful rifle shots.
notesHi: The OB47 patch removed the original 10-second cooldown, making the skill continuously active upon landing successful rifle shots.
